Name: Dawnforged Sovereign
Story Background: With the sovereign's return, the city remembered how to hope.
Ability: Flying, vigilance. When Dawnforged Sovereign enters the battlefield, you gain 8 life and create two 2/2 white Knight creature tokens.
Appearance Description: An ivory-and-gold winged sovereign descends over a holy city's stairs, with exactly two silver-armored knights below.
